falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 14 would contradict the bottom_2024_aug analog, which featured elevated volatility persistence (VIX remained 16-22 for weeks post-low); this would indicate complacency inconsistent with a genuine macro bottom and suggest the current signal is a bear market rally within a larger downtrend

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This flight-to-quality divergence would invalidate the bottom pattern because August 2024's bottom coincided with yields rising (growth scare resolving into soft landing); simultaneous falling yields and weak equities indicates recession pricing, transforming the pattern from 'growth scare bottom' to 'cyclical downturn beginning', making the HOLD signal a trap
